newsitem.title: USA: State Auto says Hurricane Fran to hurt Q3.
newsitem.headline: State Auto says Hurricane Fran to hurt Q3.

text.p: State Auto Financial Corp said on Friday that losses caused by Hurricane Fran, together with other losses on spring storms previously reported, are expected to hurt third quarter earnings by $4 million or $0.22 per share after tax.
The company said that since it has reduced its underwriting exposure in coastal areas, it was hit hardest in the Raleigh, N.C., area by Hurricane Fran.
Third quarter results will be announced the first week of November, the company said.
